posts.title: "Hot Knife" by Fiona Apple
posts.description: "Hot Knife" is a slow-burn build of staccato piano, thunderous timpani, and layered vocals that sounds like nothing else in pop.

posts.title: "Psychedelic Switch" by Carly Rae Jepsen
posts.description: Audio ice cream with another scoop of ice cream on top. This modern disco track is a killer showcase for vocal expressiveness.

posts.title: "When the Levee Breaks" by Led Zeppelin
posts.description: There's nothing like those first four bars of "When the Levee Breaks." It's the foundation of a grimy driving bluesy groove as unstoppable as the tide.
